⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Audio-aligned annotation spans.

Use for ASR words, utterances, speaker turns, VAD regions, TTS emissions,
interruption windows, and other span-like evidence.

Each row stores one or more spans using parallel arrays. Spans are logged as
queryable data, not private UI state, so downstream tooling can overlap-query
and export them alongside audio summaries and source metadata.
